body: Dvd — Semprec #119 reconstructs dormant conversations from ordered `agent_run_events`, compacts oversized history before the provider call, and requires deterministic resume after repeated restarts. I build AllSource, an event-sourced agent-memory and provenance layer. I can help test event projection at that boundary: restore message/tool invariants, record the compaction continuation, and replay the same pre-turn state without relying on process memory. Interested in a bounded comparison against Semprec’s Postgres event stream? I can offer hands-on integration or design-partner access. If not useful, reply “pass” and I will not follow up.

## Summary

Implements #119: reconstructing dormant Semp and delegated conversations from `agent_run_events` into pi-agent-core's expected `Entry[]` transcript shape, with pre-turn context sizing and low-level compaction via a new injectable `CompactionAdapter` seam (`estimateContextTokens`, `shouldCompact`, `prepareCompaction`, `compact`) — matching the issue's requirement to avoid `AgentLane.compact()` or pi internals.

Key additions:
- `conversationReconstruction.ts`: walks ordered `agent_run_events` into a chained `ConversationEntry[]` tree, resuming from a persisted `'compaction'` checkpoint when present instead of re-walking replaced history; sizes the result and compacts it when required.
- New additive `'compaction'` `agent_run_events.kind` (migration `0016`), written only by the reconstruction path, never by the live turn loop.
- `listSessionAgentRuns` query in the data package for fetching one conversation's ordered session runs.
- Wired into both `SempConversation.send()` and `DelegationRegistry.delegate()` wake paths via `createReconstructConversationHistory`/`createReconstructDelegatedHistory` factories, seeding the new session's `initialState` and persisting a compaction checkpoint when one occurred.
